title: ticket template: compliance request, mitigation (template_version 2)
description: A REQUEST for a MITIGATED disposition (the finding remains observable; a compensating control in force reduces the risk). It opens a MITIGATED_REQUEST ticket through the kit's reconciler, approved by the finalized review's human concurrence (the disposition gate in scripts/ticket_model.py). A request is NOT a disposition: nothing stops blocking until an exact, unexpired, approved disposition is merged to the protected default branch. `finding` is validated against finding.schema.json. KDEC-037.

finding.description: The finding the request is about (finding.schema.json).

justification.description: Why, in words a later reader can check (at least 20 characters).

expires.description: The request's expiry, YYYY-MM-DD. Always required: silence never renews.

requested_by.description: Who asks. Never the approver of this request.

receipt.description: A custody receipt for the evidence (a store's object id or signature).

compensating_control.description: Which control, and how it is evidenced to be in force.
